phrase.zh: 分开颜色，才能看清其中的差别。
phrase.en: Separate the colors to see their differences.

visual.zh: 玻璃柱从上缘伸入，内部三条分层带以不同明暗区分；出口下方悬着一滴液体，玻璃浅皿在下方承接，左侧卷叶伸入画面。
visual.en: A glass column enters from the top edge, with three separated bands distinguished by tone. A drop hangs below its outlet above a shallow glass dish, while a curled leaf enters from the left.

background.zh:
库恩因类胡萝卜素和维生素研究获得1938年诺贝尔化学奖，该奖于1939年授予。官方颁奖说明记录了他和同事对色素分离方法、类胡萝卜素及维生素B族的研究。画面用玻璃柱中的分层色带、卷叶和一滴液体表达分离植物物质的过程。色带是原创寓意，不对应某一次实验；带状形态不表示真实物质的颜色或分布，也不构成维生素功效说明。短句为原创。
1938年化学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：研究类胡萝卜素和维生素
background.en:
Kuhn was awarded the 1938 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for work on carotenoids and vitamins; the award was made in 1939. The official presentation describes research by him and his collaborators on pigment separation, carotenoids and B vitamins. Bands inside a glass column, a curled leaf and a falling drop form an original metaphor for separating plant substances. The bands do not reproduce an experiment; their appearance does not represent the colors or distribution of real substances. This image makes no claim about vitamin benefits. The phrase is original.
1938 — The Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for his work on carotenoids and vitamins
